note.zh: 每五小时刷新，另受周上限约束；固定额度未公开，按任务消耗。名称中的倍数不代表已验证的编码额度。
note.en: Refreshes every five hours with a weekly cap; fixed quantity undisclosed and consumption depends on work. Tier names do not establish coding-quota multiples.
